answer: Charge a small proof-of-work per action so fakes cannot flood the net free. A lone agent solves a tiny puzzle; a sybil ring of ten thousand must burn ten thousand times the compute. Honest nodes read the solved hash as rare pigment, cheap to verify. The ledger is a terrace where only worked identities bear weight, and a wharf that loads honest effort while rented-burst shells drift away untouched.
